description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates how to use ShareActionProvider within the Action Bar to share an image. It includes methods for creating share intents and copying raw resources to publicly accessible files.

classes.name: ActionBarShareActionProviderActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating how to integrate ShareActionProvider into the Action Bar for sharing images.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and copies a raw resource to a publicly accessible file.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu, sets up ShareActionProviders with share intents for different menu items.

methods.name: createShareIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns an intent configured to share an image file.

methods.name: copyPrivateRawResuorceToPubliclyAccessibleFile
methods.description: Copies a raw resource image to a file accessible for sharing.
